name: i2c_twoboards_advcomit
description: I2C_TwoBoards_AdvComIT on two NUCLEO-F446RE wired as its readme draws them (two_boards.json): I2C1 at 400 kHz, the slave's 7-bit address 0x3E, by interrupts. After B1's USER button the master repeats, every 25 ms: the write request (0x34), the count (2 bytes), its 174-byte buffer; then the read request (0x12), the count, and the buffer read back. Each board checks what it received and toggles LD2: both blink together, 19 toggles in 0.65 s (a cycle of about 34 ms); a wrong buffer would stop them with LD2 on. It needs a slave receiver to keep a byte received over what the HAL wrote to DR to clear TXE, and no STOPF after the master's NACK, as on the part.
